title: Applied Sciences Group: High Performance Touch
summary: A Microsoft Research demo from TechFest 2012 of a lab touch system that lets viewers feel the effect of different input latencies, down to about 1 ms. It shows how much more responsive dragging feels compared with typical 100 ms touch delay.
why: HN commenters cite it whenever input latency comes up, as the demonstration that people can perceive touch delay down to 1 ms.

quote.text: It shows the difference between from >100ms to ~1ms. It's mind baffling.
